mentions.name: QuiltOps
mentions.description: QuiltOps combines the Quilt patch manager with tooling to keep local package modifications up to date with upstream releases. When a new package version drops, it automatically applies your patch series, rebuilds against the patchset, and notifies you on failure.
mentions.problem: Keeping locally patched packages up to date when upstream releases new versions, since patches can fail to apply or build against new releases.
mentions.source_excerpt: still wip but QuiltOps which is basically just Quilt+Tooling so you can keep your package mods up to date with upstream. A new package drops (oh no another 0day in htop) and you want to apply your htop-but-with-xcowsay.patch and it will auto rebuild against your patchset or notify you on failure...
